Is he a ghost? Is he the living dead? A bit of both, in fact. He lingers around the place of his death and preys upon weak travellers. He left his humanity behind in his former life so no-one should expect any favours.

Quest: Fremennik Trials

Combat: The angry viking with issues is out for your blood. Last time you had to try and hunt him down, but now he's here waiting for you! He'll attack with basic melee.
params.2102: Taste the wrath of the deadliest ghost in the world!
